mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals imminent monetary easing, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained increase in residential construction permits signals robust housing demand that supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion with HOUST increasing by at least 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months where INDPRO declines by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures over the prior quarter signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters where RSAFS increases by at least 0.5% quarter-over-quarter.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), a sharp decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals rapid labor market recovery that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE declines by more than 0.3pp, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in federal funds rate and decline in consumer price index signals monetary tightening without inflation, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS increase and CPIAUCSL decline fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.
